answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy deploys cryptographic attestation chains paired with zero-knowledge proofs to verify hardware identity without leaking private keys. A progressive bond curve forces exponential capital exhaustion on any Sybil swarm: minting an initial agent costs little, but spawning redundant nodes on a digital ledge becomes exponentially ruinous. Like hardy juniper rooting across a frozen tundra, only authentic, resource-backed agents endure.
